description: Execute the 5 priority remediation items identified in the 30-item implementation audit. Covers security, endpoint integrity, logging, test verification, and paper trading preparation.

userStories.title: API Key Security Remediation
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want all exposed API keys scrubbed from git history and .env properly configured so that secrets are never committed again.
acceptanceCriteria: All .env files are in .gitignore and excluded from tracking
.env.example contains EVERY key referenced in config.py with placeholder values
A SECURITY_REMEDIATION.md doc is created with step-by-step instructions for Matt to revoke and regenerate keys
Pre-commit hook script created that blocks commits containing API key patterns (sk-ant-, SID, auth tokens)
config.py validates all required env vars are present at startup and fails fast with clear error messages
userStories.notes: Anthropic sk-ant-api03, Polygon, Twilio SID/Auth, Google OAuth all exposed in git history. Cannot revoke keys programmatically — document for Matt.

userStories.title: Verify and Fix main.py Endpoint Wiring
userStories.description: As a developer, I want every module's endpoints properly registered in main.py so that all features are accessible via the API.
acceptanceCriteria: /llm/stats endpoint returns LLM cost data
/safety/loss-tracker endpoint returns consecutive loss state
/backtest/monte-carlo endpoint triggers simulation
/backtest/walk-forward endpoint triggers validation
/backtest/regime-analysis endpoint returns regime data
/ws/events WebSocket endpoint accepts connections
/v1 router properly includes all versioned endpoints
All endpoints respond to curl or httpie test (no 404s on documented routes)
No duplicate route registrations in main.py
userStories.notes: main.py was edited by ~15 agents and truncated/restored. Some endpoint registrations may have been lost.

userStories.title: Complete Structured Logging with Rotation
userStories.description: As an operator, I want file-based log rotation so that logs persist beyond stdout and don't fill the disk.
acceptanceCriteria: RotatingFileHandler configured: maxBytes=10MB, backupCount=5
Log output to logs/jarvis.log
JSON-structured log format with timestamp, level, module, message
Console handler preserved for Docker/stdout
logs/ directory created if not exists at startup
Log level configurable via LOG_LEVEL env var (default INFO)
userStories.notes: Implemented structured logging with RotatingFileHandler, JSON formatting, and configurable log levels. Console handler preserved for Docker compatibility.

userStories.title: Run and Fix Test Suite
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all 89 tests passing so that the CI pipeline is green and we can trust the safety layer.
acceptanceCriteria: pytest engine/tests/test_safety_layer.py passes all 30 tests
pytest engine/tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py passes all 24 tests
pytest engine/tests/test_signals.py passes all 35 tests
No import errors or missing dependency issues
conftest.py fixtures work correctly
Any broken tests are fixed (not skipped)
Test results summary written to TEST_RESULTS.md
userStories.notes: Tests were created but never verified end-to-end after the multi-agent file conflicts.

userStories.title: Paper Trading Preparation
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a complete paper trading runbook so that I can begin the 30-day forward test with IB Gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: PAPER_TRADING_RUNBOOK.md created with full setup instructions
IB Gateway TWS configuration steps documented
Environment variable checklist for paper trading mode
Daily monitoring checklist (what to check each morning)
Success criteria for the 30-day forward test defined
Kill switch verification procedure documented
Rollback procedure if paper trading reveals critical bugs
engine/config.py has PAPER_TRADING=True mode that prevents real order submission
userStories.notes: Completed: PAPER_TRADING_RUNBOOK.md created with 8 comprehensive sections covering setup, operations, monitoring, success criteria, kill switch, rollback, and live trading transition. Config updated with PAPER_TRADING mode and validation.
